story: Basketball-Reference, CBS and StatMuse list New York at Atlanta for 7 October at 7:30 p.m. ET without a final. Game 1 on 4 October was Dream 92, Liberty 82. Jordin Canada scored 25 points in 32 minutes. Allisha Gray is ruled out for Game 2. Game 3 is dated 9 October in New York.
